title: Tracking Protection Settings
description: Learn about tracking protection settings and how to handle websites that may not display correctly with enhanced privacy features.
content:
Tracking Protection Settings

Understanding how tracking protection affects website functionality and how to manage exceptions for optimal browsing experience.

Heads up!

This setting may cause some websites to not display content or function correctly. We provide optional exceptions for websites that we know can be affected by your configuration.

Understanding the Impact

Enhanced tracking protection is designed to protect your privacy by blocking trackers and third-party content that could compromise your browsing experience. However, some websites rely on these elements to function properly.

Potential Issues

  • Broken website layouts
  • Missing functionality
  • Login problems
  • Payment processing issues
  • Video or media not loading

Benefits of Protection

  • Enhanced privacy
  • Faster page loading
  • Reduced data usage
  • Better security
  • Cleaner browsing experience

Managing Exceptions

To reduce the chance of broken websites, we provide optional exceptions for websites that we know can be affected by your configuration. These exceptions are carefully curated to maintain functionality while preserving privacy where possible.

1

Automatic Exceptions

Our system automatically identifies and suggests exceptions for known problematic websites, helping you maintain functionality without compromising your privacy settings.

2

Manual Overrides

If a site appears broken, you can temporarily turn off tracking protection for that specific site to load all content and report the issue.

3

Community Reporting

Report broken sites so we can help fix them for everyone. Your feedback helps improve the browsing experience for the entire community.

How to Handle Broken Sites

Step-by-Step Process

  1. Identify the Issue: Determine if the website is truly broken due to tracking protection or other factors.
  2. Temporary Disable: Turn off tracking protection for the specific site using the shield icon in your address bar.
  3. Test Functionality: Verify that the site now works correctly with protection disabled.
  4. Report the Issue: Use the reporting feature to notify us about the broken site.
  5. Re-enable Protection: Once reported, you can re-enable protection and wait for a fix.

When to Report

  • Essential functionality is broken (login, payments, forms)
  • Content is completely missing or distorted
  • The site is unusable with protection enabled
  • You've confirmed it's not a temporary site issue

Best Practices

Privacy First

  • Keep tracking protection enabled by default
  • Only disable for essential sites
  • Re-enable protection when possible
  • Use exceptions rather than global disabling

Site Management

  • Test sites before reporting
  • Provide detailed reports
  • Check for site updates
  • Use alternative sites when possible

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on managing tracking protection settings, visit our comprehensive support guide:

Learn More

Technical Details

Tracking protection works by blocking requests to known tracking domains and preventing third-party cookies from being set. This can affect sites that rely on these services for:

  • Analytics and user behavior tracking
  • Social media integration
  • Advertising networks
  • Content delivery networks
  • Third-party authentication services

Our exception system carefully evaluates each site to determine which trackers are essential for functionality versus those that are purely for tracking purposes.
